content.title: India’s CSR Spending Leaves Gaps in Health, Water Security, Innovation
content.caption: India’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) spending has left gaps in health, water security, and innovation, according to a report by Sattva Consulting and India Data Insights.

slides.heading: India’s CSR Spending Leaves Gaps in Health, Water Security, Innovation
slides.text: India’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) spending has left gaps in health, water security, and innovation, according to a report by Sattva Consulting and India Data Insights.

slides.heading: CSR Spending Overview
slides.text: India’s annual CSR spending reached ₹40,794 crore in FY25, growing at 15% annually over the past decade.

slides.heading: CSR Spending Gaps
slides.text: The report found gaps in non-communicable diseases, women’s economic agency, school-to-work transition, groundwater resilience, and innovation.
